objective.primaryRule: the actual-profit role of the C24 selectable set (qualified members of the independent and informed lane shortlists and the Intraday D1 incumbent vectors projected into F1-F4): the highest development centre net after 5 bps per side and 11% interest; ties by the lower centre maximum minute drawdown, then the canonical candidate ID (PROTOCOL.md §9.3); qualification Q1 centre net > 0, Q2 centre minute DD <= 35,000, Q3 confirmation (3 x 128) p90 minute DD <= 35,000; no qualified member: no qualifying primary

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: planned base schedule (PROTOCOL.md §7.3, budgets.ts): independent lane per family and cutoff 6 cells x 1,024 screened + 256 promoted + 4 islands x 1,024 new proposals (+ up to 2 extension islands) + rungs 48 @ 64 / 16 @ 128 + refinement ~ 10,400 proposals and ~ 88,000 evaluations (~ 12,500 / 123,000 with every extension), identical at C19, C21, C23 and C24 (16 lanes ~ 166,000 proposals, ~ 1.41M evaluations); informed lane (C24, per family) ~ 5,100 proposals / 83,000 evaluations; exploratory 2-bp lane (C24, per family, never selectable) ~ 5,200 / 45,000; qualification ~ 1,290 evaluations per member (~ 191,000). Caps with every extension: ~ 255,000 proposals, ~ 2.9M evaluations. Reports count centres, neighbours per stage, fold work, retries and archive/cache hits separately; actual counts come from the sealed search and qualification records.

deviations.description: primary = actual profit (highest qualified centre net; ties lower centre DD, then ID); balanced divides by max(selection p90 DD, $1); lower-drawdown vacant when the primary's selection robust net is not positive
deviations.justification: brief §3.1-3.2 require actual development net as the primary target and the four roles with exact formulas

deviations.description: gates Q1 centre net > 0, Q2 centre minute DD <= $35,000, Q3 confirmation p90 minute DD <= $35,000 (inclusive); the brief's 'selection/confirmation p90' resolved as confirmation for qualification, selection for ranking, rung p90 as search feasibility; no neighbourhood profit gate
deviations.justification: brief §3.1 (the neighbourhood DD gate is [S]; do not treat median/p10 profitability as a gate); standard §2.3 (confirmation qualifies, selection ranks)

deviations.description: NSGA-II with four objectives (-centre net, centre DD, -robust net, p90 DD); promotion 1/4 centre net, 1/4 robust net or constrained rank, 1/2 round robin over six protected cells (dip depth x lookback scale)
deviations.justification: brief §3.1 and §5.1 (centre net and DD central; >= 25% centre-profit promotion; protected strata)

deviations.description: radii in grid steps (B +-1 level; X, Y, S, P +-3; H, L, W +-2; U +-5); one-scope families entry {B,X,Y,L}, exit {S,H,U}, continuation {P,W}; the family fixed in every neighbourhood
deviations.justification: the Intraday D1 grid's relative radii (+-19-21%); brief §5.2 (categorical choices held fixed)

deviations.description: pooled-method arms (§3.4), multi-component participation (§4.7), combined-strategy participation (§2.7) and participation attribution (§2.9) are not applicable: one VGT book, one funded position, F1-F4 are alternatives never funded together; family on/off effects reported as causal whole-replay differences
deviations.justification: brief §3.3 ('not applicable to the primary study. Explicitly say why in the protocol')

deviations.description: single-family identity: no pool exists; parity P6 proves the worker (search) path equals the local (report) path; pooled identities n/a
episodes for concentration = calendar months with an entry; the top-month blackout rerun bars new funding there and nothing else
accounting from 2016-01-04, one common arming date 2016-02-01 for every candidate and harmonized control; native daily D1 keeps no arming date
deviations.justification: the grid's longest lookback needs >= 10 sessions of history (Intraday D1's convention); continuous runs from 2016-01-04 otherwise

deviations.description: the earlier-cutoff repeat (C19, C21, C23, identical budgets) covers the independent four-family procedure; the informed lane and the exploratory 2-bp lane run at C24 only (every incumbent and informed seed was selected or diagnosed with data through 2024, after each earlier cutoff); the chronological verdict tests the independent procedure only and the C24 primary may come from the informed set
deviations.justification: no cutoff-eligible informed seed exists at C19-C23, and an informed fold carries no chronological evidence (§1.9)
deviations.userAgreement: brief research/intraday-dip-recovery-vgt/brief/BRIEF.md §4: 'Run full search and frozen selection for each, using the same declared budget, criteria, families and independent-lane construction as the main cutoff'; §3.3: 'Earlier-cutoff folds may use an independent lane as chronological evidence only to the extent that seeds, ranges and selection genuinely exclude later-selected configurations and examined outcomes'
